eligibility_evidence: IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR (TOP SECRET CLEARANCE) SpaceX is looking for a Sr.
Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance Preferred Skills And Experience Significant experience designing, deploying, supporting and troubleshooting classified networks.

Additional Requirements Active Top Secret or TS/SCI with Polygraph. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law. review_candidates.title: Head of IT Infrastructure & Support
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You will be responsible for service delivery, operational stability, infrastructure governance, risk management, major incident management, and continuous service improvement across a complex enterprise environment. What You Will Bring 15+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Technology Operations, or Service Delivery environments.
eligibility_evidence: Experience working within large-scale enterprise or hybrid IT environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What You Will Bring 15+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Technology Operations, or Service Delivery environments. Strong expertise in enterprise infrastructure operations and ITIL/ITSM practices. Technical expertise across VMware, Nutanix, Windows, UNIX/Linux, Storage, Backup, Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Citrix VDI, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Exchange, Microsoft 365, Azure, IAM, NAC, Symantec, and Microsoft Defender. Preferred certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft Azure, VMware, Nutanix, Citrix, CISSP, CISM, PMP, or PRINCE2.
